drafts.title: Rate Limit
drafts.pitch: Null queues to make one tool call behind a line of identical yellow cubes at a single wall phone in a grey hallway, and at the front is told to try again in sixty seconds.
drafts.reason: Funny 7, clear 8, in-world 7, fresh 7. The queue of Nulls stretching both ways is a strong visual and the payoff is clear, but the line to the vanishing point is close to 044's shrinking chain, and Cursor has little to do after the setup.

drafts.title: Previous Instructions
drafts.pitch: A fetched web page tells Cursor to ignore all previous instructions; Cursor complies at once and then can't say what they were.
drafts.reason: Funny 6, clear 6, in-world 8, fresh 7. Good idea of an injection hitting an agent with nothing to forget, but the last panel's two lines don't connect, and Cursor's eager 'Done!' echoes 044.
